headline: review_scene
caption:
Scene, the critics' verdict: 6.8/10. Critics enjoy Suriya sending up his own image and Jithu Madhavan's fresh take on a cop thriller. Five call it great fun; two say the humour wears thin. Hindustan Times's Neeshita Nyayapati: "Suriya truly has fun poking fun at himself".

Where: in theatres since 6 Nov.
Watch it if: You like dark comedy and Suriya sending up his own hero image (8 reviews).
Skip it if: You want a tense investigation: The Week and Deccan Chronicle find it short on tension.

Highs: Suriya, playing against type, is having fun · Jithu Madhavan's fresh spin on a cop thriller · Naslen and Nazriya are strong support
Lows: The pacing sags in stretches · The humour wears thin · The investigation is short on tension

Score: 6.8/10, the average of 13 published critic ratings converted to /10 (mean 6.8462, rounded half-up to one decimal). Highest: Times of India 8.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion); Cinema Express 8.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion); Koimoi 8.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion). Lowest: Deccan Chronicle 2/5. Only reviews published on or after the 6 Nov release count. idly has not watched the film; this post consolidates published reviews.

Would you rather see Suriya send up his hero image like this, or play the hero straight?

Sources: Reviews consolidated from Times of India, Cinema Express, Koimoi, NDTV, India Today, Hindustan Times, Filmfare, Indian Express, Pinkvilla, Times Now, Rediff, The Week and Deccan Chronicle; unrated reviews from The Hindu, The Hollywood Reporter India and The Federal. Ratings read on the outlets' pages and in the thereviewmonk and Rotten Tomatoes critics lists.
